approaches_tried.approach: First deploy-headless.sh run was launched concurrently with Phase 4 source edits still in progress
approaches_tried.reason: Race: the deployed tree captured a partial edit state, causing test-runtime-file-tracking.sh (which resolves the deploy tree before the source store) to see a stale 20-member lib paired with a stale standards doc, and separately surfaced an unrelated pre-existing specs/TODO.md/state.json sync drift (task 329's own status transition to IMPLEMENTING had not yet been regenerated into TODO.md). Fixed by finishing all source edits first, regenerating TODO.md via generate-todo.sh, then redeploying once cleanly.
